newsitem.title: UK: Key index shows strong economic growth in Britain.
newsitem.headline: Key index shows strong economic growth in Britain.

text.p: Britain's Purchasing Managers' Index -- a key guide to economic performance -- rose to a seasonally adjusted 54.5 percent in October, an 18-month high, from 53.5 percent in September, figures showed on Friday.

In a separate report, independent economic advisers to the government predicted strong economic growth of an average 3.4 percent next year. They said Britain's budget deficit between 1997 and 2000 would be under the 3.0 percent of GDP target required to enter a single European currency.
